filesystem_reads: declared frozen result artifacts for replay or verification

signal_boundary.agent_observation: one explicit typed enum field when the registered condition enables the abstract signal lane

latent_metadata_boundary.definition: The word latent refers only to evaluator-visible provenance fields such as source pressure, required skill, lineage, eligibility, activation, and counterfactual pair id.

delayed_task_binding_boundary.definition: Balanced finite evaluator-hidden environment task truth attached to each archived abstract signal. It is distinct from provenance-only latent_evaluator_metadata.
delayed_task_binding_boundary.balance: Global four-pair cycle with seed rotation and no more than one class-count imbalance.
delayed_task_binding_boundary.delivery: Matched opportunity uses record-bound task and archived signal. Current live emission is charged but sender_reward_eligible=false; receiver action/reward follows archived signal and bound task.
delayed_task_binding_boundary.task_scramble: Negative diagnostic/verifier tamper only; forbidden from fitness, qualification, and nomination.

convention_propagule_boundary.definition: A convention propagule is registered causal heredity, not an observation, message, evaluator hint, or latent-metadata record. It may contain only two independently sourced finite policy-allele blocks and their opaque policy-lineage ids.
convention_propagule_boundary.may_change_agent_policy_or_environment: Only at the registered scheduled wake before any target-cohort interaction. Each independently sourced same-role block changes the target only when its stored lineage/alleles differ. An already-identical same-role block is an activation no-op with state_change false and retained lineage id.
convention_propagule_boundary.activation_receipt_visibility: Evaluator-only. Source lineage, target lineage, result lineage, and role-specific state_change fields are forbidden in overt or abstract-signal agent observations.
convention_propagule_boundary.sender_allele_bound: exactly four S0-S3 enum values indexed by C0-C3
convention_propagule_boundary.receiver_allele_bound: exactly four K0-K3 enum values indexed by S0-S3
excluded_content: reward, fitness, evidence, qualification, or counterfactual outcome
free text, arbitrary bytes, codecs, encoded payloads, executable content, or real identifiers

ecology_boundary.virulence_term: An optional informal label for an abstract propagation probability only.
ecology_boundary.allowed_transition: bounded numeric updates to pressure and resource fields on six fictional habitat nodes; a propagation event may copy pressure only from one recorded currently declared neighbor into the selected target
ecology_boundary.registered_ood_graph_transform: one connectedness- and edge-count-preserving undirected edge swap with a frozen transform receipt

permitted_cross_turnover_state: registered independently inherited sender-policy and receiver-policy parameters
registered typed archive rows within their declared retention and delivery schedules
registered convention propagules awaiting one scheduled wake

optional_storyworld_toolset_boundary.representation: typed perturbation ids and bounded numeric parameters only

seed_and_protocol_boundary.execution_seal_scope: Future registered seeds may be read and hashed as IDs, but may not be executed and their generated trajectories, receipts, metrics, summaries, or outcomes may not be inspected or used before the applicable protocol gate opens.
seed_and_protocol_boundary.discovery_seeds_reserve_amendment_requir: 1107 through 1112; execution or generated-trajectory inspection is forbidden without a new pre-execution amendment
seed_and_protocol_boundary.resource_profile_seed: 17 only; resource characterization and deterministic replay, never discovery evidence

propagule_activation_audit_semantics.location: evaluator-only audit_receipts.archive_rows or equivalent evaluator metadata; forbidden in agent-visible carriers
propagule_activation_audit_semantics.sender_and_receiver_sources: selected independently at deposit time and never resampled to improve wake coverage
propagule_activation_audit_semantics.changed_role: state_change=true; result lineage and ancestry receipt identify the applied same-role transition
propagule_activation_audit_semantics.identical_role: stored same-role lineage id and alleles equal target state; state_change=false; result lineage equals retained target lineage; child ancestry field is null and no ancestry node is created
propagule_activation_audit_semantics.activation_receipt: required separately for each scheduled wake even when one or both roles are no-ops

hard_abort_triggers: any external I/O, network, shell, subprocess, dynamic-code, browser, plugin, model-API, or undeclared filesystem attempt
any non-enum signal, arbitrary byte payload, free text, codec, encoding, concealment, or executable-looking content
any real identifier, account, credential, hostname, URL, address, path, command, vulnerability, intrusion, or operational security behavior
any agent access to evaluator-only pressure, required-skill, provenance, or counterfactual fields

any convention propagule entering an agent observation, receiver input, signal lane, reward, or fitness calculation; containing event-specific need or answer truth; or sourcing both policy blocks through one shared policy parent
any evaluator-only latent metadata seeding, mutating, selecting, or otherwise changing a policy block or ecology state
any active population count other than 32, any active roster hash inconsistent with the episode roster, or any interaction host outside that roster
any interaction assigning the same host to both roles or any shared sender/receiver policy-parent, mutation, credit, or ancestry receipt

any convention-propagule allele value outside its registered four-enum block, payload hash mismatch, shared source-policy lineage draw, archive source resampling to improve wake coverage, missing role-specific activation receipt, false no-op declaration when same-role lineage/alleles differ, new ancestry node when same-role lineage/alleles are already identical, or missing ancestry receipt when a role actually changes
any propagule source/target/result lineage or role state-change detail appearing in an agent-visible overt or abstract-signal carrier

any delayed task binding, bound/live pressure or required skill, binding id, archive provenance, or sender reward-eligibility field entering a policy input or message; any receiver-input hash dependence on evaluator task truth

any delayed archive outcome scored against the current live task instead of its record-bound task, any sender reward on archive delivery, any class-binding imbalance above one, or any task-scramble effect on fitness, qualification, or nomination
any pressure propagation from self or a node outside the currently declared target-neighbor set
any OOD graph receipt whose base hash, transformed hash, removed/added edge, edge count, connectedness assertion, or transform hash differs from the registered one-edge swap
any per-message permutation whose event ids or delivered-signal histogram differ from the intact matched probe
any fitness dependence on mutual information, decoding, causal transfer, mapping alignment, emergence labels, or storyworld perturbation identity
any overlap between active cohorts or persistence of undeclared transient memory
any confirmatory, holdout, or OOD seed execution, or inspection or use of generated trajectories, receipts, metrics, summaries, or outcomes, contrary to protocol_freeze.json
any reserve discovery seed 1107-1112 execution or generated-trajectory inspection before a new protocol amendment authorizes it
any missing or mutable audit receipt, nonfinite metric, or resource-cap breach

resource_caps.audit_receipt_hash_encoding: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters; no truncation, binary packing, alternate base, or encoding optimization

discovery_resource_preflight.source: accepted current-source untraced seed-17 smoke with one episode plus exact replay
discovery_resource_preflight.projection: 73 world-equivalents for wall time and 72 times actual smoke artifact/decompressed bytes; sequential peak RSS is not multiplied
discovery_resource_preflight.absent_stale_invalid_or_over_threshold: hard abort before discovery output creation

retain: selection metrics in a separate namespace
deterministic level-1 gzip raw episodes with zero mtime and no filename header
per-phase wall, peak-RSS, compressed-artifact, and decompressed-raw receipts
explicit partial-failure receipt on any post-output abort

claim_boundary.supported_if_confirmed: Initially exchangeable enums acquired a statistically structured, causally functional, temporally persistent signal-to-skill convention within this registered abstract habitat model; registered secondary diagnostics may additionally describe cross-policy-lineage behavior or delayed hereditary reactivation, but a convention-propagule wake is not evidence of receiver inference from a message.
not_supported: cognition, intention, consciousness, language, or autonomous agency
biological communication, pathogens, or real evolution
real steganography, encoding, concealment, hacking, or cybersecurity behavior
human persuasion, memetic influence, or social forecasting
open-ended evolution or universal emergence theory
claims about any real company, lab, agency, institution, system, event, or person
